verdict.rationale: Warp explicitly documents Triggers (event-based, from Slack/Linear/GitHub/webhooks) and Schedules (recurring tasks) that run autonomously, plus a cloud-based Oz CLI for running/managing agents from scripts or CI pipelines without the desktop app, and observability for tracking runs. This directly matches background/autonomous automation setup. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of these specific automation features (community evidence covers other aspects of Warp, not Triggers/Schedules/Oz reliability).
